idea-plugin.name: Flow Language
idea-plugin.description: JetBrains IDE support for the Flow language (https://github.com/noah-freelove/flow-sharp). Wraps the flow-lsp language server via LSP4IJ — completions, hovers, signature help, and diagnostics from the same server that powers VSCode (Phase 17). Requires the `flow` binary on PATH (provided by Phase 30's `flow install`); set FLOW_LSP_PATH as a fallback. See README.md for details.

server.name: Flow Language Server
server.description: Flow LSP via the `flow lsp` subcommand (Phase 31 Plan 01 LspCommand delegates to flow-lsp/Program.cs). Binary discoverability falls back to the FLOW_LSP_PATH env var when `flow` is not on PATH — see FlowLanguageServerFactory.kt and README.md for details.
